reviews.title: Noise Monitoring
reviews.text: Has identified my snore sleep alerts. Eat last and sleep snore of the chart. Eat light and sleep, drastic difference. Eat 4-plus hours and sleep snore score way low. Also for me silent acid reflux when eating late life identified. Tried P-AC (not sure if brand can be ID’ed) and found during two week trial, took before meal time as directed and it kept score down too. So, I now know eat earlier hours before sleep and feel fresh! SnoreLab helped identify controls to better (lower) snore score!

reviews.title: Too warm
reviews.text: I discovered, with the help of the App, that my snoring is related to my brain thinking I am too warm while sleeping. Sleeping just under a sheet has reduced my snoring about 80 or 90 %.

reviews.title: App is great the pestering is not
reviews.text:
This app does a great job of recording and scoring. Also gives helpful advice. What isn’t ok is I pay the money for it yet every single day multiple times a day I am asked to write a review? And it doesn’t matter if I say “not now” . So just today I’ve been asked 11 times. And that’s all the time. If it were free I would understand the endless pestering but I pay so I’m mad. Makes me want to cancel. Infuriated 

Update: now that I’ve written this review the problem seems to have gotten worse. I was asked 6 times in 2 minutes to leave a review. Which I JUST DID???

reviews.title: Excellent for sleep monitoring
reviews.text: Easy to use. The best app. And it’s free.  It records your breathing all night and when you wake up you click Results and can listen to your breathing and see your snore results score and see your snores all night classified by intensity and how long you snored and can click Breathing to see the % of time your breathing was stable. Can click Trends to see your average breathing score over the time you’ve been recording your breathing using the sleep lab app. Can also click to read useful info about snoring, etc.

reviews.title: Almost Perfect—Eye Opening
reviews.text:
Most would give this app five stars—I’m close.
I thought I barely snored. My partner joked about it, and I brushed it off. Then I used SnoreLab… and actually heard myself. I was shocked.
No wonder she wasn’t sleeping well—and neither was I.
That moment changed everything. I started taking sleep seriously, and this app was a huge help. It’s not an instant fix, but it gives you real insight and helps you improve faster.
If you think your sleep is “fine,” try this—you might be surprised.
We all deserve better sleep.

reviews.title: This app has been extremely useful
reviews.text: I downloaded this app in 2018 when I realized I might have a sleep disorder.  My sleep disorder got much worse for several years after that, and SnoreLab proved it to me, even vwhen two sleep doctors denied it.  SnoreLab helped me figure out which devices or medications worked and which didn't.  When the dental device reduced my snoring, SnoreLab showed me that, and that convinced me that excess weight was my problem.  That gave me the confidence to seek out a weight-loss drug, and then the ability to see that it was working.  I now know that I DID have a sleep disorder, thanks to SnoreLab, and then I had the knowledge necessary to solve it, after the doctors let me down.

reviews.title: Effective
reviews.text: I was shocked to be told I was a loud snorer.  Knowing this can have bad effects on my health, I  looked for a solution and tried SnoreLab. The recordings were stunning.  So I began the SnoreGym exercises, and started working through the variety of options. I was seeing small improvements. And finally I tried an appliance that worked for me! My scores have dropped from the 80s to single digits (usually 3-5). Very grateful!

reviews.title: Helps monitor my sleep apnea

I recently purchased anti snore pillows and was able to see in the data a reduction in my snoring which confirmed that this addition was beneficial to getting better sleep. If you have sleep apnea this is a great tool to monitor your breathing at night, the data is very useful to your doctor as well.
